method: Every non-merge android/contracts commit in forkPoint..nativeAuthority is either patch-id identical to a commit in the frozen 801cf798 history (a rehashed copy, already audited) or listed in commits[]. Subjects, bodies, new files and changed hunks were read. Android PlaybackRootDegreeCueTest passed 22/22 at nativeAuthority before pinning.
decisions: 2026-11-18 owner: commit the local Android edits, then pin that commit (3c887223).
2026-11-18 owner: ship the exact speech clips, downloaded on first spoken-cue use and cached.
2026-11-18 owner: port the new Library layout and rewrite the Settings Back test against it (replaces options A-E).

commits.featureDelta: Adds audible root-degree pulses under Playback chords.
Adds spoken root-degree cue selection and bundled Kokoro degree clips.
Pitches spoken degrees to the chord root and adds concise chord-quality suffix clips.
Separates the lower root-degree voice from Roman chord-detail speech.
Fits chord voice cues to playback tempo, transpose and key context.
Distinguishes dominant-seventh and major-seventh spoken suffixes.
Announces suspended chords and restores the af_heart voice for all clips.
Adds an independent voice volume for spoken cues.
Describes the current melody note role and adds root-only melody plus scrub bar.
Colors melody roles: green sits, blue leans, amber moves, red outside the chord.
Shows and speaks one/two-word melody functions below C5 and adds a Help article; mode-change voice without tonic; full spoken suffix names.
Shows the live value inside each playback dial.
Shows melody function above the full-chord card and reserves the caption row during rests.
Adds the Melody chord tones cue: speaks only chord-member melody notes.
Adds Harmonic Distance: held tonic plus pulses per circle-of-fifths step; Lock in Major measures from the opening relative major.
Adds one pulse to every non-tonic distance (distance 1 = 2 pulses, tritone = 7).
Moves the say-aloud button beside Reset; the instrument button shows a saxophone.
Song mode continues into the next section and wraps; Loop repeats the section; toggling keeps the playhead.
Groups voice choices under Melody/Chord/Pulses titled sections, Off first.
Renames the dialog Metadata Speak Aloud and tightens rows.
Renders Playback at the display maximum refresh rate instead of a 60 Hz vote.
Saves playback controls per song in Room schema v5 song_playback_settings.
Draws the melody timeline on the display frame clock instead of recomposing per note.
Splices the next queued section inside the audio block with no gap.
Opens Favorites under the Library search buttons.
Shuffles example songs from the Library by popularity cutoff, opening on the chorus and holding each song.
Pitches key-change mode speech to the new tonic including transpose.
Schedules key-change mode speech in its own window at the end of the current chord, tonic in C3-B3.
Replaces the Any chip and free-text cutoff with a minimum-popularity menu.
Voice ceiling 1.4x with a tanh soft limiter above 0.85; compact Favorites rows.

features.behavior: Root Pulses and Harmonic Distance cues: tonic held, plus (circle-of-fifths distance + 1) decaying pulses per non-tonic chord root; Lock in Major measures from the opening relative major.
features.acceptance: Exact PCM equality with native renderer fixtures for pulse onsets, decay, count, tonic hold and the Lock in Major reference.

features.behavior: Spoken Number and Sung Number + Details cues: degree clips pitched to the root register, accidentals, chord suffixes from Roman/voicing, key-change mode speech in its own end-of-chord window at the new tonic (C3-B3, with transpose), independent voice volume, 1.4x ceiling and tanh soft limiter.
features.acceptance: Byte-identical clip assets (SHA-256), bit-exact Sonic port and exact PCM equality with native fixtures for phrase scheduling, pitching, gain and limiter; clips download only when a spoken cue is enabled.

features.behavior: Melody function: chord-member/non-chord-tone classification, sit/lean/move/outside colors, caption on the melody card and above the full-chord card (row reserved during rests), Melody function and Melody chord tones speech below C5, Help article.
features.acceptance: Native MelodyFunctionTest and SingingMelodyRegisterTest cases reproduced exactly; product browser check of caption, colors and reserved row.

features.behavior: Voice control beside Reset opening the Metadata Speak Aloud dialog (Off, then Melody/Chord/Pulses groups) with voice volume; saxophone instrument icon.
features.acceptance: Accessible dialog with native option order and titles; changing the cue does not restart transport.

features.behavior: Per-song saved playback settings (lock, tempo, arpeggio, balance, instrument override or null = Settings default, transpose, cue, voice volume, loop), sanitized on load; a new song publishes defaults immediately.
features.acceptance: Native SongPlaybackSettingsViewModelTest semantics; reload persists per song; bad stored fields fall back to defaults. Status 2026-11-18: store, session and Playback wiring for lock/tempo/arpeggio/mix/instrument/transpose done; cue, voice volume and loop are stored but have no UI until N07/N09/N11.

features.behavior: Song mode plays into the next section in song order (wrapping) with an in-block splice; Loop repeats the section; toggling does not move the playhead.
features.acceptance: Exact PCM continuity across the splice versus a native fixture; section label and timeline follow the continuation.

features.behavior: Playback timeline and playhead render on the display frame clock at maximum refresh; the Settings Display 60fps/Maximum preference is removed.
features.acceptance: No Display section in Settings; the timeline redraws every animation frame from the playback clock.

features.behavior: Tempo/arpeggio/mix dials show their live value inside the dial.
features.acceptance: Value text matches native formatting; delivered together with N04 rotary drag and tap reset.

features.behavior: Library home relayout: search header and scope, Aural Quiz row, example-shuffle row, self-scrolling Favorites box under the search buttons, compact 48dp rows, All Songs row.
features.acceptance: Native order and sizing; Settings Back restores the Favorites/All Songs inner scroll, replacing the library.spec.ts:49 window.scrollY assertion per the 2026-11-18 owner decision.

features.behavior: Example-song shuffle: Aural catalog example songs filtered by a minimum-popularity menu, shuffled into the queue, each opening on its chorus (or first section) and held until the listener advances.
features.acceptance: chorusOrFirstSection and cutoff semantics match native tests; the queue holds each song until next/previous.

features.behavior: Root-only Playback shows the current melody note, a timeline scrub bar and the melody-function description.
features.acceptance: Root-only layout matches native rows; scrub seeks silently like the full timeline; N01 root gauge unchanged.
